items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: we was coming from Vachery, Louisiana... the drum player he broke his ankle. Who was that? We called him Lagre Mas

ctx.x: You were on Greyhound? Yeah, we was on Greyhound. In those days I guess they weren't so modern anyway. No they weren't so modern.

So all the other people, they wanted to get on ahead of us, so the bus driver told them and said no, so let these musicians get on first because if it don't be for him, none of us would have got home, see, we'd have turned over, you know, off the highway. So we got in the bus and sit down and put our instruments up and come on into town. But I can tell when them cars go to swing, you see, that's it, turn over right now. But I done been in a gang of them on the road. But just luck enough I didn't get quite too…
You ran your car up into the barbershop? Yes, indeed.
